in_marathi.name: Ilango
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ilango हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ilanga' meaning 'Sun'. In Hindu mythology, Ilango is a name of the Sun God, Surya. This name is believed to bring strength, vitality, and warmth to the bearer.

in_bengali.long_meaning: Ilango একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ilanga' meaning 'Sun'. In Hindu mythology, Ilango is a name of the Sun God, Surya. This name is believed to bring strength, vitality, and warmth to the bearer.
